name: echo
description: Echo the provided text (harmless example CLI tool).

name: fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return the raw body (generic HTTP tool).

name: dangerous
description: Example destructive tool gated by devil_mode.

name: whois
description: WHOIS lookup for a domain/IP (passive recon; requires network in sandbox).

name: dig
description: DNS lookup for a domain (passive recon; requires network in sandbox).

name: http_request
description: Re-fetch one in-scope URL (GET by default), non-destructive re-probe of scan leads.

name: session_login
description: Submit the target login form once and keep the authenticated session for the run (returns only cookie names, never values).

name: form_discover
description: Discover editable forms on an in-scope URL (input-vector re-probe).

name: header_reprobe
description: Re-fetch an in-scope URL and report its security headers (misconfig re-probe).
